calls.title: User Journeys
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing user journey visualization through simplified Sankey Diagrams to clarify paths and improve interactions. Key features to improve exploration include locking paths and hover states, while the need for clearer drop-off and cohort analysis tools was emphasized. The data model focuses on a single fact table for efficient querying and optimized SQL for performance. Additionally, an AI-powered chat interface is envisioned to facilitate natural language exploration and seamless interaction with analytics tools. The team aims to release user journeys this month, balancing speed and quality in development efforts.
calls.keywords: User Journeys, Sankey Diagram, Event Tracking, AI Analyst, Product Analytics, SQL Queries
